newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK post-handover govt seeks views on officials' pay.
newsitem.headline: HK post-handover govt seeks views on officials' pay.

text.p: Hong Kong's future leader Tung Chee-hwa has called for public input on salary levels for his executive staff and members of the post-handover government.
The British colony is handed back to China later this year.

The Independent Commission on Remuneration for members of the executive council and the Legislature of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region has until July 1, the date of Hong Kong's return, to make its recommendations.
The public's views are being sought on appropriate remuneration packages for members of both bodies.

"While we shall make reference to the existing system, we would welcome comments from members of the public on the whole range of issues we should consider under our terms of reference," a commission spokesman said.
"Their views will help greatly the commission in working out reasonable, equitable and practicable recommendations," he said.
Details on present salary levels for government officials were not immediately available.
